reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a half-full battery with a lightning bolt indicating charging. It is an ideal, glanceable symbol for tasks about charging devices, managing rechargeable batteries, or buying/packing power banks, though it shares visual elements with other battery-level and electrical-power icons.

readings.meaning: charging battery or recharging a device

pass1.ambiguity: Because the lightning bolt cuts off the right cap of the battery, at very small sizes the open right side can look like a C-shaped magnet or a broken plug.
